paragraphs: Resimplifi describes its offering as AI-native commercial real estate data and listings. The company states that it combines AI-assisted sourcing with direct human verification to keep listing data current, complete, and ready for integration. Every listing runs through a four-step cycle that the site says averages more than 2,000 new listings every day.

The source step scans thousands of sources, including broker sites, FSBO listings, and municipal records. Listings are cross-checked against the original source so that status, pricing, and specs reflect what is actually true. LLMs extract and structure additional property details from source materials for every listing.

Products are offered for brokers, associations, and economic development organizations. Named clients on the site include the Kansas City Area Development Council and the Bradenton Area Economic Development Corporation. Organizations quoted on the site include the City of Warner Robins, Gadsden County, and Forward Forsyth.

quote.text: Whether you're a broker, an association, or an economic development organization, there's a Resimplifi product built for how you work.
